body:
The repository-URL test from #16 reads `process.env.GITHUB_REPOSITORY`. Deno runs the suite with `--allow-read` only, so it threw `NotCapable: Requires env access to "GITHUB_REPOSITORY"` on all three OSes, and the release after #16 stopped at the test gate (0.14.0 is still unreleased, see #19).

Under Deno the test now skips the environment comparison, using the existing `readOnlyRuntime()` helper. Node and Bun still compare against `GITHUB_REPOSITORY` in CI. Verified locally: node 6/6, `deno test --allow-read` 6/6.

After this merges, the release still needs the npm trusted publisher moved to `link-foundation/disk-space-saviour` (one npm 2FA approval).

title: Fix the Deno test failure that blocks the 0.14.0 release
